question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Vinay missed his flight, but **__good luck came to him from bad circumstances__** as the flight crashed into the sea.

options.text: it was a blessing and a curse
it was a blessing in disguise

solution:
The correct answer is** ****"it was a blessing in disguise."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The expression** "it was a blessing in disguise" **means that something initially perceived as a negative or unfortunate event turns out to have positive, beneficial, or advantageous consequences in the long run. (किसी चीज़ को शुरू में नकारात्मक या दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण घटना के रूप में देखा जाता है, लेकिन लंबे समय में उसके सकारात्मक, लाभदायक या लाभकारी परिणाम सामने आते हैं)

 
 
• **Example**: *After losing my job, I thought it was a disaster, but looking back, **it was a blessing in disguise**__*.
 
 
 
• In other words, the true value or positive aspect of the situation becomes apparent only after some time has passed.
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 4.​
